name: failure-predict
description: Failure predictor. Analyzes task + approach against immune system, past failures, environment constraints, complexity, and curriculum readiness. Returns verdict: WILL_FAIL / HIGH_RISK / LOW_RISK / LIKELY_SUCCEED with reasoning.

commands.predict: Predict failure risk for a task. Usage: predict "<task>" ["<approach>"]
commands.check-env: Check environment constraints for a task. Usage: check-env "<task>"
